response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL calibrstatus are grouped together as their own group (NULL), not excluded.
Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded by the >= 47.6 filter.
